what: When the screen-height photo panel enters the view, the current slide shrinks straight from 1.1x to 1x over 5s, and when fully shrunk it moves on to the next, repeating. The thumbnails in the control panel below wait behind the current one with the next two stacked and offset by 15px each, and are pulled forward one slot each time over 1s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), while the passed one slides out 54px to the left (reversed when going back). The caption changes in .25s and is advanced with the ← · → buttons

options.dur: How long each slide stays (shrinks), in seconds, default 5
options.zoom: Scale when the section first enters, default 1.1
options.--fx-step · --fx-out · --fx-thumb: Thumbnail overlap gap, drop-away distance and thumbnail width (via style), defaults 15px · 54px · 50px
options.--fx-shift · --fx-ease: Thumbnail push length and curve (via style), default 1s · cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)
options.--fx-edge · --fx-edge-color: Width and color of the dark edge shown on the right of the thumbnail (set via style), default 4px · --kf-contrast-bg
options.[data-fx-part=page]: Photo section (multiple) — stacked inside the same frame. The first child (photo) is cloned for the thumbnail
options.[data-fx-part=thumbs]: Slot for the thumbnail (optional) — give it a height, width is the thumbnail plus about two overlap cells (80px)
options.[data-fx-part=caption]: Description text per section (optional, one per section) — stacked in the same cell
options.fx:page: When the section changes, the elements { page } Carries out a
